meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 当要求执行分阶段计划时,Claude会变成总指挥,自己不动手,而是分阶段派出「实现」「验证」「反模式检查」「代码质量审查」「提交」「分支同步」等子代理执行,自己只负责调度与验收;某一步未通过验证,就不进入下一步、也不提交。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 执行、运行或实施一个计划时触发,尤其是计划由 make-plan 生成时。

say.text: 执行当前计划的第一阶段。
say.note: 会先派出「实现」子代理执行该阶段,并要求给出完成证据。

say.text: 按计划推进,每完成一步先验证。
say.note: 每个阶段结束都会先运行验证检查清单。

say.text: 执行这份计划,全部验证通过后提交。
say.note: 验证未通过前不会提交代码。

howto.what_en: On execute-plan requests, Claude orchestrates: it does not implement itself; it deploys per-phase subagents (implementation, verification, anti-pattern check, code-quality review, commit) and does not proceed until verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute the first phase of the current plan.
say_en.note: Deploys an Implementation subagent for that phase.

say_en.text: Run the plan step by step, verifying each phase.
say_en.note: Runs a verification checklist after each phase.

say_en.text: Execute this plan and commit only after verification passes.
say_en.note: Commit only occurs if verification subagents pass.
